job.name: l2h_cover_a
job.person_note: The presenter must look exactly like the young curly-haired archaeologist in the first attached frame.
job.style: A finished YouTube-style COVER (thumbnail) for an online history lesson, 16:9, in EXACTLY the visual style of the attached frames from the lesson video: warm semi-realistic digital painting / modern animated-film illustration, golden Egyptian palette (sand, gold, warm orange) with deep teal accents, a teal textured border band with small Egyptian lotus ornaments. The presenter is the young curly-haired archaeologist from the attached frame (same face, curly brown hair, short beard, green shirt, leather bag strap) — keep him recognisable. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: big title «Тутанхамон и золотая маска» (two lines max) and a small pill label «Урок истории». No other words, no logos, no watermarks. Strong focal point, high contrast, readable at small size.
